title: saveclear
description: `saveclear` sends a `clear` message to a subpatch before an unspecified event, making it useful for dynamically generated subpatches. In the example, `saveclear pd-$0.my-subpatch` targets the same named subpatch receiver used by `s pd-$0.my-subpatch`; the help text is truncated, so its full behavior and purpose cannot be established.
